wikitext: {{Unknown name}} {{Incomplete}} {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Team Rocket's Secret Base |image=Team Rocket Alola base.png |characters= |japanese= |region=Alola |colorscheme=Alola |epicode=SM004 |episode=First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style! }} '''Team Rocket's Secret Base''' is a cave in the [[Alola]] [[region]], on [[Melemele Island]], which the {{TRT}} have claimed as their [[Secret Base]]. ==History== The cave first appeared in ''[[SM004|First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!]]'', where the {{TRT}} were first shown there after a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{an|Bewear}} had dragged [[Jessie]] and [[James]] there, with {{MTR}}, [[Jessie's Wobbuffet]], and a wild {{TP|Jessie|Mimikyu}}, that Meowth had brought along, following behind them. Jessie eventually caught Mimikyu before Bewear began to give them food. Later in the episode, Team Rocket tried to take back the [[Berry|Berries]], which some wild {{p|Pikipek}} and a {{p|Trumbeak}} had stolen from the cave, in order to show Bewear that they were thankful for how nicely it had treated them, but were unsuccessful in taking the berries back. In ''[[SM012|The Sun, the Scare, the Secret Lair!]]'', Team Rocket claimed the cave as their [[Secret Base]], due to the fact that they had all started to enjoy living there. James also caught {{TP|James|Mareanie}} here. In ''[[SM016|They Might Not Be Giants!]]'', Team Rocket started to decorate the Secret Base, but were interrupted when [[Lana's Popplio]] and [[Ash's Rowlet]] had crashed into it. In ''[[SM018|A Seasoned Search!]]'', Team Rocket had finally finished decorating their Secret Base. ==Pokémon seen in the Secret Base== {| style="margin:auto; width: 50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Secret Base|Bewear|Bewear anime.png|Normal|Fighting|link=Bewear (anime)}} | | | |} {{-}} {{stub|Anime}}
